name: How long does kitchen plumbing installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen plumbing installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen plumbing installation varies depending on the complexity of the project. A straightforward replacement of a sink and faucet in an existing setup might take a few hours. A full kitchen remodel or new construction, requiring extensive pipe work, new drain lines, and multiple appliance hookups, could take several days to a week. Factors such as access to existing plumbing, necessary permits, and the condition of current pipes can also influence the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: The time for kitchen plumbing installation varies, from a few hours for simple replacements to several days for full remodels.
